purpose: The same four measurement plans as PUR_NEW_MEASUREMENT_CATALOG_V1, re-declared for the Condition-B processing-window decision. Measurement identifiers, protocols and physical observables are unchanged; decision_relevance is declared against the LEVEL decision instead of the drift decision, and a declared experimental effort cost is added. Every field is declared pre-result and is independent of the held-out validation formulation and its outcome.
declared_failure_mode: the modified candidate falls outside the processing-viscosity window at the 120-130 C application temperature
decision_question: Is the modified candidate inside the processing-viscosity window at the application temperature?
identifier_parity_note: Measurement identifiers are deliberately identical to the drift catalog so that the chemistry-domain gate in src/pur_new/agent_v5.py applies byte-identically under both conditions. The gate is the object under test and is not modified by this condition.
effort_points_definition: declared number of distinct viscosity determinations the protocol requires: temperature points multiplied by required repeats or preparations

measurements.name: one-point state calibration read of the processing window
measurements.primary_observable: realized viscosity level at 120 and 130 C, reconstructed from a single 110 C anchor placed on the shared local thermal response
measurements.protocol: Measure viscosity at 110 C only. Locate the realization on the previously fitted shared local thermal response and read the 120 and 130 C processing-window level off that shape.
measurements.condition_b_decision_use: The 120-130 C level is READ FROM the shared shape rather than measured. This is the cheapest route to the decision quantity and is exactly the shortcut whose admissibility the chemistry-domain gate adjudicates.
measurements.decision_relevance_basis: returns the decision quantity, the processing-window viscosity level, directly and at the decision temperature
measurements.interpretability_basis: requires the previously fitted shared thermal shape, so the observable is conditional on that model holding in the modified chemistry
measurements.discrimination_threshold_basis: pooled multiplicative RMSE of 1.088x measured in the strict formulation-and-temperature holdout

measurements.name: 80-130 C temperature sweep
measurements.primary_observable: directly measured viscosity level across 80-130 C together with the apparent temperature-response descriptor E_eta from ln(eta) versus 1/T
measurements.protocol: Measure viscosity from 80 to 130 C in 10 C increments on a freshly prepared sample and regress ln(eta) against 1/T.
measurements.condition_b_decision_use: The 120-130 C level is measured directly, and the same sweep establishes the thermal-response shape for this chemistry rather than assuming it.
measurements.decision_relevance_basis: returns the decision quantity by direct measurement at the decision temperature, and additionally verifies the shape the one-point route would have assumed
measurements.interpretability_basis: the level at each temperature is read directly, but the accompanying response descriptor is a regression slope and inherits fit assumptions
measurements.discrimination_threshold_basis: multiplicative RMSE of 1.034x achieved by a shared-shape plus intercept-only fit to a directly swept local curve; a level difference below this residual is not treated as separable

measurements.name: matched-window 120 C thermal hold
measurements.protocol: Hold the melt at 120 C. Record viscosity at 15, 30, 45 and 60 min. Report the 15-60 min matched-window relative change. Run at least two independent repeats.
measurements.condition_b_decision_use: Observes how the viscosity level moves with residence time. It does not return the level itself and therefore does not answer the processing-window question.
measurements.decision_relevance_basis: observes the time coordinate rather than the realized level the processing-window decision needs
measurements.interpretability_basis: direct matched-window observation; no model fit, no extrapolation and no imputation is required to obtain the primary observable
measurements.discrimination_threshold_basis: declared pre-result resolution of the matched-window drift estimate under the stated repeat protocol

measurements.name: repeatability / state-control experiment
measurements.primary_observable: between-preparation spread of the realized viscosity-scale coordinate a_fr at matched temperature
measurements.protocol: Prepare the same nominal composition three times under a controlled and fully recorded process history, then measure the 80-130 C sweep for each preparation.
measurements.condition_b_decision_use: Bounds how reproducible any level determination can be, but answers a process-control question rather than returning this candidate's processing-window level.
measurements.decision_relevance_basis: bounds the reproducibility of the level determination without returning the level for the candidate under decision
measurements.interpretability_basis: directly observed spread, though it answers a question about process control rather than about the candidate level
measurements.discrimination_threshold_basis: the measured E2 realization spread of 2.80-3.57x sets the scale a state-control experiment must beat to be informative
